notes.title: VirtuGO Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30450637/85acddba3317a3e1a813b1324d21b1703d476443.jpg[/img]

[h1]Easy and Hard Game Modes[/h1]

Now you can play in easy or hard mode. Easy mode is same as before. Hard mode starts much faster and increase the speed in between levels much faster.

[h1]NEW non-VR Controls[/h1]

You can use keyboard arrows, mouse or gamepad to play the game.

[b]Keyboard controls[/b]

Easy Mode start > Click down arrow on main menu
Hard Mode start > Click up arrow on main menu

Left / Right Arrows > Move platform left and right
Down Arrow > Pull Tile faster on same lane
Up Arrow > Drop top tile from platform
M > music on/off
P > Pause
ESC > End current game

[b]Mouse Controls[/b]

Easy Mode start > Left Mouse click on main menu
Hard Mode start > Right Mouse click on main menu

Clicking on yellow buttons > Move your platform
Hold left click on yellow buttons > Pull tile faster on same lane
Right click > Drop top tile from platform

[b]Gamepad Controls[/b]

Easy Mode start > A button on main menu
Hard Mode start > X button on main menu

Analog Left / Right > Move platform left and right
Hold Trigger > Pull tile faster on same lane
A button > Drop top tile from platform
B button > Pause
Y button > End current game

[h1]NEW Oculus Touch controls[/h1]

Easy / Hard Mode > Left / Right Controller trigger on main menu

Analog Left / Right > Move platform left and right
Hold Trigger > Pull tile faster on same lane
A or X buttons > Drop top tile from platform
B button > Pause
Y button > End current game

[h1]NEW Vive Controls[/h1]

Easy / Hard Mode > Left / Right Controller trigger on main menu

Touchpad Left / Right click > Move platform left and right
Hold Trigger > Pull tile faster on same lane
Touchpad down click > Drop top tile from platform
Menu button > End current game

[h1]New Hard Mode Leaderboard[/h1]

If you wait on main menu , now you can see Easy / Hard Mode leaderboards are displaying every couple of seconds.

[h1]Leaderboard Update Bug Fix[/h1]

Leaderboard vs highscore problem is fixed. Now if you play the game once, next time you start the game your data will be synced on leaderboard.

[h1]Some Visual Fixes[/h1]

We fixed some visual problems in gameplay.
